facts.value: 170 built-in stitches (page) vs 172 (brochure); manual refers to stitch 172
facts.note: Janome's own page and brochure disagree by two stitches; list under conflicts.

facts.value: Janome gives 'Workspace W 10 in x H 4.7 in' and '10 in all-metal seamless flatbed'; no needle-to-arm figure
facts.note: Our 10 in throat has no maker source for needle-to-body. Janome's 10 in is workspace width, so under rule 11 the throat is not confirmed.

site.label: Throat space
site.juki: Janome states a 10 in workspace width and 4.7 in height, not a needle-to-arm distance.
site.others: Dealers and owners call it a 10 in throat.

facts.value: Extra high lift; manual says about 7 mm (1/4 in) above the normal raised position
Superior Feed System Plus (SFS+), 7-piece feed dog; no built-in AcuFeed
facts.spec_value: Top-loading full rotary hook; one-push needle plate conversion
facts.note: AcuFeed is an optional accessory on the 6650; the 6700P has it built in.

facts.value: Automatic thread cutter; remote cutter port is an optional accessory
Not stated on the page or brochure; manual needle kit lists #11/75 and #14/90 needles and a twin needle
facts.note: Spec was null. No system designation published.

facts.value: Independent bobbin winding motor only; main motor type and wattage not published
12 included accessory feet per the page; brochure lists zigzag A, overcast M, 3 mm rolled hem, zipper E, satin F, blind hem G, darning PD-H, buttonhole R and a convertible foot
facts.spec_value: Zigzag foot, blind hem, overcast, satin stitch, rolled hem, zipper, darning, free motion quilting set, automatic buttonhole foot
facts.note: The page rolled hem foot is 2 mm and the brochure says 3 mm.

facts.value: 25 year limited; electronic components 5 years, labor 1 year (OCR of Janome's warranty PDF); Amazon listing says 25 Year Limited Warranty
facts.note: Spec was null. Component split is from OCR text, so verify against the PDF before quoting. Per the OCR text the warranty is void if the machine is not bought from an authorized Janome dealer in the United States, and commercial use is limited to 1 year. Check whether an Amazon or Costco listing is an authorized sale.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 25 years limited per Janome's warranty document; the OCR text gives electronics 5 years and labor 1 year.

facts.value: 6 LEDs in 3 locations (page); 3 high-powered LED lights (brochure)
6700P: 200 stitches plus 5 alphabets, 1,200 spm, built-in AcuFeed, 3 needle plates, 17 feet, extension table, knee lift, $3,999; same size, weight and 10 in flatbed as the 6650
